hypotheses: SMER-3 may inhibit CDK9 or other transcriptional CDKs, reducing RNA Pol II CTD phosphorylation and altering H3K27/H3K36 methylation patterns; donor roscovitine (CDK inhibitor) would share this mechanism.
SMER-3 may inhibit ATM/ATR/DNA-PK, causing replication stress and compensatory histone mark changes; donor KU-55933 (ATM inhibitor) would share this mechanism.
SMER-3 may induce DNA double-strand breaks, leading to histone modification changes; donor etoposide (topoisomerase II inhibitor) would share this mechanism.
SMER-3 may activate sirtuins or alter NAD+ metabolism, affecting histone acetylation and methylation; donor resveratrol (sirtuin activator) would share this mechanism.
SMER-3 may inhibit JAK2/STAT signaling, indirectly affecting chromatin modifiers; donor momelotinib (JAK2 inhibitor) would share this mechanism.
